articles.title: Kerala Dhanalekshmi DL-73 Lottery Result Today (October 14): ₹1 crore jackpot draw begins at 3 PM;... - Moneycontrol.com
articles.full_text:
The Kerala State Lotteries Department is scheduled to conduct the Dhanalekshmi DL-73 lottery draw on Wednesday, 14 October 2026, offering a first prize of ₹1 crore. The draw will take place at 3 pm at Gorky Bhavan near Bakery Junction in Thiruvananthapuram, with the official results expected to be published later in the afternoon.
The weekly lottery has a ticket price of ₹50 and features multiple prize categories, including ₹30 lakh for the second prize and ₹5 lakh for the third prize. Participants can check the winning numbers against their tickets once the results are announced. The official results should be verified through the Kerala State Lotteries Department's website or its published result gazette.
The Dhanalekshmi lottery is part of Kerala's weekly lottery programme, which also includes draws such as Sthree Sakthi and Karunya. The department operates the scheme under the Government of Kerala, with tickets sold through authorised agents and vendors across the state.
Kerala Lottery Dhanalekshmi DL-73 Prize Structure
The DL-73 draw offers prizes ranging from ₹100 to ₹1 crore. The first, second and third prizes are awarded to one winning ticket each, while several lower prize categories provide additional opportunities for ticket holders. A consolation prize of ₹5,000 is also available for eligible tickets from other series bearing the first-prize number.

The number of winning tickets in the lower prize categories depends on the prescribed draw combinations. Ticket holders should check the complete official result list before concluding that a ticket has won.
Dhanalekshmi DL-73 Result: How to Check Winning Numbers
The draw is scheduled to begin at 3 pm, and the results are generally published after the draw process is completed. Participants should use the official result notification to confirm their ticket numbers and corresponding series.
To check the Dhanalekshmi DL-73 result, follow these steps:
- Visit the official Kerala State Lotteries Department website.
- Look for the Dhanalekshmi DL-73 result for 14 October 2026.
- Check the winning numbers and series against the details printed on your ticket.
- Review the complete prize list, including the consolation and lower-tier prizes.
- Retain the original ticket if it matches a winning number and follow the department's official claim procedure.
Results may also be published in newspapers. Participants should rely on the department's official notification for final confirmation of winning numbers and prize eligibility.
Kerala Lottery Prize Claim Rules and Deadlines
Winners must submit their claims within 30 days, according to the stated claim guidelines. Prizes of up to ₹1 lakh can be claimed through the relevant District Lottery Office, while claims exceeding ₹1 lakh must be submitted to the Director of State Lotteries with the required documents.
The claim process generally requires the original winning ticket, a signed ticket copy, identity documents, a PAN card copy and two attested passport-size photographs. Winners may also need to submit a prize receipt bearing a ₹1 revenue stamp. Additional documents, such as guardianship papers or joint declarations, may be required in applicable cases.
Ticket holders should sign the reverse of the winning ticket and keep it secure. They should check the department's latest instructions before submitting a claim, as documentation and verification requirements may vary according to the prize amount and circumstances.
The Kerala lottery system operates under the Lotteries (Regulation) Act, 1998. The state conducts weekly draws and special bumper lotteries during festivals such as Onam, Vishu, Christmas and New Year, with some bumper first prizes exceeding ₹10 crore.
Revenue generated through the lottery system supports government activities and social welfare initiatives, including the Karunya Benevolent Fund, which provides assistance to eligible patients facing medical expenses. The department's authorised ticket distribution network also supports employment across the state.
Participants awaiting the Dhanalekshmi DL-73 result should check the official announcement after the scheduled draw and confirm all details before making a prize claim.

articles.title: നെയ്യാറ്റിന്‍കരയില്‍ ഒന്നിച്ച് മദ്യപിക്കുന്നതിനിടെ വാക്കേറ്റം; രണ്ടുപേര്‍ക്ക് കുത്തേറ്റു - Siraj Daily
articles.search_term: (സൂര്യാഘാതം OR "ഹീറ്റ് സ്ട്രോക്ക്" OR "ചൂടേറ്റ് മരണം" OR "വെയിലേറ്റ് മരണം" OR നിര്‍ജലീകരണം OR "ആശുപത്രിയില്‍ പ്രവേശിപ്പിച്ചു" OR "ചൂടുമൂലം അസുഖം") Kerala
articles.full_text:
തിരുവനന്തപുരം | നെയ്യാറ്റിന്കരയില് ഒന്നിച്ച് മദ്യപിക്കുന്നതിനിടെയുണ്ടായ വാക്കേറ്റത്തെത്തുടര്ന്ന് രണ്ട് യുവാക്കള്ക്ക് കുത്തേറ്റു. അതിയന്നൂര് പ്ലാവിള സ്വദേശി രഞ്ചിത്ത് (33), വഴുതൂര് സ്വദേശി വിനോദ് (35) എന്നിവര്ക്കാണ് കുത്തേറ്റത്. സംഭവത്തിന് ശേഷം ഒളിവില് പോയ സനലിനായി പോലീസ് അന്വേഷണം ഊര്ജിതമാക്കി.
ചൊവ്വാഴ്ചയായിരുന്നു സംഭവം. മദ്യപിക്കുന്നതിനിടെ ഇവര് തമ്മില് കടുത്ത തര്ക്കമുണ്ടാവുകയും ആ പ്രകോപനത്തില് സനല് കൈയിലുണ്ടായിരുന്ന ആയുധം ഉപയോഗിച്ച് രഞ്ചിത്തിനെയും വിനോദിനെയും കുത്തുകയുമായിരുന്നുവെന്ന് പോലീസ് പറഞ്ഞു.
പരുക്കേറ്റ ഇരുവരെയും ഉടന് തന്നെ നെയ്യാറ്റിന്കര ജില്ലാ ആശുപത്രിയില് പ്രവേശിപ്പിച്ചു. ഇരുവരുടെയും പരുക്കുകള് ഗുരുതരമല്ലെന്ന് ആശുപത്രി അധികൃതര് വ്യക്തമാക്കി.
